title: Photographs of Hal Puthoff's layered magnesium-bismuth metal

tellings.quote: No. I've seen photographs of the of this thing that Hal had.

plain: A man named Hal Puthoff is said to have held a sample of metal made of thin layers of magnesium and bismuth, of the kind said in UFO stories to come from unknown craft. A man named Dan Sheehan tells Michels he has not handled it but has "seen photographs of this thing that Hal had." If the sample is what it is claimed to be, it would be physical material from an unexplained craft.
